meta.name: bonus-stack-builder
meta.description: Design exclusive bonus packages that make YOUR affiliate link the obvious choice. Triggers on: "create bonuses for", "bonus stack", "what bonuses should I offer", "bonus ideas for", "exclusive bonuses", "differentiate my affiliate link", "why buy through my link", "affiliate bonuses", "bonus package", "what can I offer as a bonus", "design bonuses", "build a bonus stack".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计专属奖金包，让推广链接脱颖而出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做联盟推广，需要为链接设计独特优惠来提升转化
copy.tagline_en: Design exclusive bonus packages to make your affiliate link stand out
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are in affiliate marketing and need unique bonuses to boost conversions

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你设计专属的奖金包（bonus packages），让你的推广链接更有吸引力。它会根据你推广的产品、你的技能和受众痛点，生成具体可交付的奖金，并计算总价值。
howto.when: 当你说出“设计奖金”、“奖金包”、“我该提供什么奖金”、“如何让我的链接脱颖而出”等关键词，或询问如何提高转化率时触发。

say.text: 帮我为HeyGen联盟链接设计奖金包
say.note: 技能会分析产品并生成奖金列表

say.text: 我是内容写手，推广Semrush，有什么奖金推荐？
say.note: 技能会结合你的技能定制奖金

howto.what_en: This skill designs exclusive bonus packages to make your affiliate link stand out. Given a product, your skills, and audience pain points, it generates specific, deliverable bonuses with perceived value and a stack total.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'create bonuses for', 'bonus stack', 'what bonuses should I offer', 'exclusive bonuses', or ask how to differentiate your affiliate link.

say_en.text: Design a bonus stack for my HeyGen affiliate link.
say_en.note: The skill will research the product and propose bonuses.

say_en.text: I promote Semrush as a content writer. What bonuses should I offer?
say_en.note: The skill will match your skills to product gaps.
